name: Danang International Marathon 2027
short_description: A multi-distance road race held in Da Nang, Vietnam on 21 March 2027, featuring full marathon, half marathon, and 10 km options.
ai_summary: The Danang International Marathon 2027 takes place on 21 March 2027 in Da Nang, Vietnam, offering three distance options: a full marathon (42.195 km), a half marathon (21 km), and a 10 km race. Registration for this event opens on 8 July 2026. Runners of varying experience levels can choose the distance that suits them best, all set against the coastal city of Da Nang.
pros: Flat, certified course along My Khe Beach, the Han River and the bay
Stations every 2 km with water, electrolyte drink and toilets
Seven-hour marathon limit suits slower runners
Large international field: 1,269 marathon finishers in 2026
cons: 24°C and 94% humidity at the 3am start in 2026
One steep climb over Thuan Phuoc Bridge at about 33 km
Four intermediate marathon cut-offs that require about 10 minutes per kilometre
Entry fees for foreigners of up to 2,200,000 VND for the marathon

faqs.question: When is the Danang International Marathon 2027 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Danang International Marathon 2027 is scheduled to take place on 21 March 2027. The event will be held in Da Nang, Vietnam, a coastal city in the country. This date gives runners a clear target to plan their training and travel arrangements around for the race.

faqs.question: What distance options are available at this race?
faqs.answer: The Danang International Marathon 2027 offers three distance options for participants to choose from: a full marathon of 42.195 km, a half marathon of 21 km, and a shorter 10 km race. This allows runners of different experience levels and goals to select the distance that best fits their training.

faqs.question: When does registration open for the Danang International Marathon 2027?
faqs.answer: Registration for the Danang International Marathon 2027 opens on 8 July 2026. This gives prospective participants several months of lead time before the event to plan their entry, arrange travel to Da Nang, Vietnam, and prepare their training schedule ahead of the March 2027 race date.

faqs.question: Where is the Danang International Marathon 2027 held?
faqs.answer: The race is held in Da Nang, a city in Vietnam, and this location serves as the venue for the event. Da Nang hosts all three distance categories of the race, the full marathon, half marathon, and 10 km, making it the central hub for participants traveling to the event.
